scope: Current ChatGPT desktop (Chat, Work, and Codex), Codex desktop lineage and CLI, plus a separately labelled Classic desktop comparison. Hosted tools are included only at their desktop integration boundary.

features.feature: Create chats in a project
features.assessment: Project-scoped chat creation and provider selection are wired into the workspace.

features.feature: Chat outside a repository
features.assessment: Chats accept a working directory; this is not the separate hosted ChatGPT Chat experience.

features.feature: Organize local projects
features.assessment: Local projects have names, icons, ordering, and grouped conversations.

features.feature: Use several folders in one project
features.assessment: Additional directories are passed as runtimeWorkspaceRoots and sandbox writable roots.

features.feature: Use cloud knowledge projects
features.assessment: Sele projects are local directory metadata; no hosted project files, sources, or shared workspace model.

features.feature: Rename conversations
features.assessment: Sele updates the stored Codex thread name.

features.feature: Pin conversations
features.assessment: Persistent local pins and a pinned sidebar group.

features.feature: Reorder chats and project groups
features.assessment: Drag ordering persists in Sele metadata.

features.feature: Archive and restore provider conversations
features.assessment: The Done group is Sele metadata; it does not call thread/archive or thread/unarchive.

features.feature: Delete provider conversations
features.assessment: No provider thread/delete action in Sele.

features.feature: Search all past conversation content
features.assessment: Sidebar filtering and find-in-chat exist; no Codex thread/search or full-history content index.

features.feature: Find text in the open conversation
features.assessment: Find highlights matches in the rendered conversation; unloaded history is outside its search.

features.feature: Resume saved Codex conversations
features.assessment: Paginated history and existing CLI threads load through app-server.

features.feature: Fork a conversation
features.assessment: Forking uses thread/fork and can continue from earlier work.

features.feature: Edit and resubmit earlier prompts
features.assessment: Codex history mutations and turn regeneration are implemented.

features.feature: Send instructions during a running turn
features.assessment: Steer, queue, and interrupt delivery modes are implemented.

features.feature: Queue, edit, and remove follow-up messages
features.assessment: Sele stores queued messages and exposes editing and deletion; provider durable-queue integration is separate.

features.feature: Use the provider’s durable queue API
features.assessment: Sele has its own queue; no thread/queue/* RPC integration.

features.feature: Open a temporary side conversation
features.assessment: No /side action or isolated side-chat workflow. Forking is available.

features.feature: Start a non-persistent Temporary Chat
features.assessment: Regular user chats are persisted; ephemeral internal title-generation threads do not provide this UX.

features.feature: Publish a read-only thread snapshot
features.assessment: No hosted share link or provider thread-publishing flow.

features.feature: Continue the same Work chat on other devices
features.assessment: No Work Cloud coordination or cross-device conversation sync.

features.feature: Track unread and completed work
features.assessment: Sidebar tracks seen timestamps, running state, pending input, and completion.

features.feature: Use a combined activity inbox
features.assessment: Sidebar status badges exist; no dedicated Activity inbox with Work/Chat/Scheduled filters.

features.feature: Import Claude or Cursor setup and history
features.assessment: Multiple providers are supported, but no externalAgentConfig import workflow.

features.feature: Export a transcript as a file
features.assessment: No whole-conversation export action; individual text can be copied.

features.feature: Generate a dedicated session recap
features.assessment: An ordinary prompt can request a recap; Sele does not dispatch the CLI /recap command.

features.feature: Choose from the live model catalog
features.assessment: Available models come from model/list; hidden models are filtered.

features.feature: Adjust reasoning effort
features.assessment: Provider-advertised effort values are mapped dynamically.

features.feature: Select Fast and Ultrafast service tiers
features.assessment: Advertised service tiers are passed to thread and turn requests; account eligibility still applies.

features.feature: Change models during a conversation
features.assessment: Each turn carries its model, effort, and service tier.

features.feature: Use ChatGPT conversational model modes
features.assessment: Sele exposes coding-provider model catalogs; no ChatGPT Chat/Thinking/Pro router.

features.feature: Switch between Chat, Work, and Codex modes
features.assessment: Codex can perform general tasks, but Sele has no native ChatGPT Chat or Work session mode.

features.feature: Configure alternate or local model providers
features.assessment: Codex config can define OpenAI-compatible, Azure, OSS, or Bedrock providers; no Sele setup wizard.

features.feature: Use Amazon Bedrock credentials and models
features.assessment: Requires a compatible installed Codex configuration; no account/bedrock/setup UI.

features.feature: Configure enterprise authentication gateways
features.assessment: Provider configuration may work; gateway OAuth RPCs and managed setup are not integrated.

features.feature: View context-window consumption
features.assessment: Token updates populate context usage and usage panels.

features.feature: Compact a long conversation
features.assessment: Sele explicitly calls thread/compact/start.

features.feature: Automatically compact and recover long sessions
features.assessment: The installed Codex harness owns automatic compaction and context limits.

features.feature: Run without OpenAI via a local inference server
features.assessment: Possible through compatible Codex provider configuration; not a bundled Sele model runtime.

features.feature: Set, edit, and clear a persistent goal
features.assessment: Goal get/set/clear RPCs and an objective editor are implemented.

features.feature: Pause and resume a persistent goal
features.assessment: The UI edits or clears objectives and can stop turns; dedicated goal pause/resume controls are absent.

features.feature: Set explicit goal token and time budgets
features.assessment: Goal data includes token budgets, but the goal setter only sends objective text; no budget editor or elapsed-goal UI.

features.feature: Keep working toward a goal across turns
features.assessment: The installed goal-capable Codex harness owns continuation and goal transitions.

features.feature: Toggle the provider’s dedicated planning mode
features.assessment: Plan display exists, but ProviderTurnOptions has no collaborationMode and Sele sends no plan-mode settings.

features.feature: Inspect a live task plan
features.assessment: Plan items and deltas render above the composer.

features.feature: Run independent conversations concurrently
features.assessment: Provider clients and project chats maintain independent conversation state.

features.feature: Let Codex delegate to subagents
features.assessment: Delegation comes from enabled Codex multi-agent capabilities, not Sele’s own agent executor.

features.feature: Read subagent status and transcripts
features.assessment: Subagent summaries and paginated histories are integrated.

features.feature: Directly message, interrupt, or resume a subagent
features.assessment: Subagent transcript inspection and cancellation are implemented; direct message/resume controls do not cover the full CLI agent-management surface.

features.feature: Define custom agent roles and model choices
features.assessment: The underlying Codex configuration owns role definitions and delegation policy.

features.feature: Execute JavaScript that composes tool calls
features.assessment: Codex supplies Code Mode and its executor; Sele displays nested calls.

features.feature: Show every nested tool with a specialized label
features.assessment: The nested-call recognizer has a fixed allowlist and MCP/web/image prefixes; new namespaces may remain generic.

features.feature: Wait, poll, and read the clock
features.assessment: Depends on installed Codex tools and enabled clock/sleep capabilities.

features.feature: Choose read-only, workspace-write, or full access
features.assessment: Sele passes sandbox policies and workspace roots to Codex.

features.feature: Choose user approval or no-prompt execution
features.assessment: Sele maps its controls to Codex approvalPolicy.

features.feature: Use an automatic action reviewer
features.assessment: auto_review is passed as approvalsReviewer where approval policy permits.

features.feature: Approve shell-command execution
features.assessment: Command requests enter Sele’s pending-approval flow.

features.feature: Approve file modifications
features.assessment: File-change requests enter the pending-approval flow.

features.feature: Approve ordinary browser consent prompts
features.assessment: Only browser permission elicitations recognized by the bridge are supported.

features.feature: Answer arbitrary MCP elicitation forms
features.assessment: Non-browser MCP forms are not handled by handleServerRequest.

features.feature: Complete specialized authentication challenges
features.assessment: Browser authentication challenges are deliberately excluded from ordinary allow/deny routing.

features.feature: Grant tool-requested permission scopes
features.assessment: item/permissions/requestApproval is not handled.

features.feature: Handle client-executed dynamic tool requests
features.assessment: item/tool/call is not handled; normal provider/MCP tool execution is separate.

features.feature: Approve arbitrary connector tool calls
features.assessment: Command/file/browser flows exist; there is no complete app-tool approval implementation.

features.feature: Approve a retry after automatic-review denial
features.assessment: No thread/approveGuardianDeniedAction integration.

features.feature: Answer synchronous and asynchronous agent questions
features.assessment: Blocking/nonblocking questions, suggested choices, and text replies are supported.

features.feature: Apply command rules from rules files
features.assessment: Codex loads configured execution policy rules. Sele has no rule editor.

features.feature: Respect locked organization feature requirements
features.assessment: Sele reads configRequirements/read and locks constrained feature controls.

features.feature: Select named permission profiles
features.assessment: Sele exposes three fixed sandbox modes rather than permissionProfile/list.

features.feature: Use command-network isolation and allowlists
features.assessment: Codex owns enforcement; Sele always sends networkAccess:false in sandboxed turns and has no full policy editor.

features.feature: Use the provider’s OS sandbox implementation
features.assessment: Codex supplies Linux/macOS/Windows isolation; not implemented by the Sele renderer.

features.feature: Provision or diagnose the Windows sandbox
features.assessment: windowsSandbox setup/readiness RPCs are not exposed.

features.feature: Complete provider user verification and attestation
features.assessment: No userVerification/* UI or attestation/generate request handler.

features.feature: Export runtime telemetry through OpenTelemetry
features.assessment: Available through provider configuration; Sele’s diagnostic log is separate.

features.feature: Use provider-managed credential storage
features.assessment: Codex owns login caches and secure-storage behavior.

features.feature: Discover local, project, system, and admin skills
features.assessment: Sele lists Codex-reported skills with scope and metadata.

features.feature: Explicitly select a skill in the composer
features.assessment: Skill mentions are sent as structured skill inputs.

features.feature: Let the agent choose skills automatically
features.assessment: Skill selection and instruction loading are owned by Codex.

features.feature: Enable or disable individual standalone skills
features.assessment: Skill configuration is updated and disabled skills can be restored.

features.feature: Associate plugin skills with connected apps
features.assessment: Installed plugin details associate namespaced skills with app IDs.

features.feature: Create reusable skills using the agent
features.assessment: The agent can write SKILL.md assets; no dedicated Sele skill builder.

features.feature: Install skill-declared tool dependencies
features.assessment: Provider feature support does not prove Sele can complete all approval and authentication flows.

features.feature: Manage additional skill search directories
features.assessment: No skills/extraRoots/set integration.

features.feature: Teach skills by recording desktop actions
features.assessment: No Record & Replay recorder or recording consent UI.

features.feature: List installed connected apps and their skills
features.assessment: app/installed and plugin metadata populate provider settings.

features.feature: Enable or disable an installed connected app
features.assessment: Sele writes app enablement and toggles associated skills.

features.feature: Mention an installed app or skill
features.assessment: Composer resource menu supports installed app and skill selections.

features.feature: Expose recommended plugins to the agent
features.assessment: A setting controls features.recommended_plugins on new threads.

features.feature: Browse and search the universal plugin directory
features.assessment: Sele lists installed resources; it has no plugin/search or full marketplace browsing UI.

features.feature: Install, connect, update, and remove plugins
features.assessment: Installed apps can be toggled; Codex plugin/install, plugin/uninstall, and marketplace management are not integrated.

features.feature: Complete an agent-requested plugin install
features.assessment: The provider may emit install suggestions; no dedicated install continuation flow is evident.

features.feature: Sign in and connect a new plugin account
features.assessment: No mcpServer/oauth/login or native connector authorization UI. External preconfiguration may work.

features.feature: Call tools from already connected plugins
features.assessment: Compatible Codex tools can execute; availability depends on installation, credentials, and the request types used.

features.feature: Render plugin-provided interactive UI
features.assessment: Text, images, and Sele visualizations render, but no Apps/MCP UI widget host is implemented.

features.feature: Run plugin browser or interface extensions
features.assessment: Generic tool transport exists; an extension host and lifecycle are not established.

features.feature: Use the hosted Plugin Creator workflow
features.assessment: A configured Plugin Creator may run via Codex; Sele has no native builder/directory workflow.

features.feature: Share plugins with teams or marketplaces
features.assessment: No plugin/share/* or marketplace management UI.

features.feature: Load local or repository plugin packages
features.assessment: Preconfigured Codex marketplaces/plugins may load; Sele has no install or packaging manager.

features.feature: Configure STDIO or HTTP MCP servers
features.assessment: Codex reads mcp_servers from config; no Sele MCP connection editor.

features.feature: Inspect server status and tool schemas
features.assessment: No mcpServerStatus/list or detailed MCP tool browser.

features.feature: Reload MCP configuration from the UI
features.assessment: No config/mcpServer/reload action.

features.feature: Read MCP resources through agent tools
features.assessment: Provider-supported resource tools may work; Sele does not itself implement resource RPC browsing.

features.feature: Subscribe to MCP events and trigger work
features.assessment: No mcpServer/event/stream API integration or event-driven task UI.

features.feature: Discover deferred tools on demand
features.assessment: Provider tool search is inherited; installed resource listings are not a complete tool registry.

features.feature: Execute configured lifecycle hooks
features.assessment: The Codex runtime owns project, user, and plugin hooks.

features.feature: List, trust, inspect, and configure hooks
features.assessment: No hooks/list UI or managed-hook configuration editor.

features.feature: Load layered AGENTS.md instructions
features.assessment: The provider discovers user, repository, and directory instructions.

features.feature: Edit project instructions or notes
features.assessment: Repository files can be edited; Sele also offers working-directory notes.

features.feature: Generate a starter AGENTS.md
features.assessment: An ordinary prompt can create it; no dedicated /init dispatcher.

features.feature: Use local Codex memory extraction and retrieval
features.assessment: Possible when enabled in the installed Codex config; behavior has not been exercised.

features.feature: Choose memory read/write mode per conversation
features.assessment: No thread/memoryMode/set integration or per-chat memory toggle.

features.feature: Inspect, reset, and manage remembered context
features.assessment: No memory/status or memory/reset UI. Config feature toggles are a narrower capability.

features.feature: Use account-level ChatGPT saved memories
features.assessment: Sele does not access or synchronize ChatGPT account memory.

features.feature: Personalize using earlier ChatGPT conversations
features.assessment: Sele conversation history is not ChatGPT account history or its personalization service.

features.feature: Choose conversational personality and response traits
features.assessment: Instructions and model settings can steer output; no ChatGPT personality or trait editor.

features.feature: Capture Computer History for later context
features.assessment: No desktop activity collector, history store, exclusions, or history controls.

features.feature: Suggest the next prompt in the composer
features.assessment: No thread/prediction/request integration or prediction acceptance UI.

features.feature: Show proactive context-based task suggestions
features.assessment: No suggested-prompts or daily-brief feed.

features.feature: Use an embedded tabbed browser
features.assessment: Sele has scoped browser tabs, navigation, and persistent browser partitions.

features.feature: Scope browser tabs globally, by project, or by chat
features.assessment: Browser automation shares the configured workspace and checks ownership.

features.feature: Let Codex automate the built-in browser
features.assessment: Compatible OpenAI Browser Use discovers Sele as iab and supports uploads, downloads, and flattened cross-origin frames; secure authentication UI and remote forwarding remain unavailable.
features.verification: isolated Electron + installed Browser Use runtime

features.feature: Read page accessibility and target elements
features.assessment: Sele implements accessibility references and element lookup behind the provider bridge.

features.feature: Click, type, scroll, and fill page forms
features.assessment: Scoped browser operations support mouse, keyboard, and form input.

features.feature: Capture browser screenshots and crops
features.assessment: Screenshots work for visible and hidden background tabs.

features.feature: Run browser page JavaScript
features.assessment: Supported page/CDP operations are exposed through the browser bridge.

features.feature: Inspect console and network activity
features.assessment: Bounded console/network history is available; no complete native Browser Developer mode UI.

features.feature: Reuse browser login sessions
features.assessment: Cookie import exists; platform/browser availability and encrypted-cookie access can limit it.

features.feature: Manage downloads through the browser runtime
features.assessment: Scoped download authorization, progress events, completed local paths, and shared download tools are implemented and exercised through the installed Browser Use runtime.
features.verification: isolated Electron + installed Browser Use runtime

features.feature: Upload local files through browser automation
features.assessment: Multiple local files can be uploaded through the native runtime file chooser or shared file-input tools; runtime uploads inside out-of-process frames remain unsupported.
features.verification: isolated Electron + installed Browser Use runtime

features.feature: Use a secure isolated sign-in form
features.assessment: No specialized browser authentication interface.

features.feature: Edit per-site browse/download/upload policies
features.assessment: The OpenAI runtime retains security policy; Sele has no full site-policy settings UI.

features.feature: Forward in-app browsing to SSH/container agents
features.assessment: Remote browser forwarding is explicitly unsupported.

features.feature: Automate complex cross-process frames
features.assessment: Flattened cross-origin iframe reads and clicks are exercised through the installed runtime; non-flattened attachment and runtime file uploads in out-of-process frames remain unsupported.
features.verification: isolated Electron + installed Browser Use runtime

features.feature: Emulate browser sizes and mobile devices
features.assessment: Viewport sizing exists; complete user-agent/touch device emulation is not established.

features.feature: Comment on pages and adjust styles visually
features.assessment: No browser annotation picker or style-controls interface.

features.feature: Use tools exposed by websites through WebMCP
features.assessment: Requires provider/runtime WebMCP support; the bridge has no demonstrated WebMCP lifecycle tests.

features.feature: Use the external Chrome side-chat extension
features.assessment: Sele provides its own browser; no external-extension integration.

features.feature: Let the agent operate native desktop apps
features.assessment: Sele implements a browser bridge only; separately installed computer-use tools may work without Sele integration.

features.feature: Capture another app’s screenshot and accessible text
features.assessment: No native appshot capture flow or app/window picker. Clipboard image attachment is separate.

features.feature: Manage native-app permissions and locked use
features.assessment: No always-allowed apps UI, locked desktop session, or system-permission onboarding.

features.feature: Dictate prompt text with a microphone
features.assessment: No microphone recorder or transcription flow.

features.feature: Hold a live spoken conversation
features.assessment: No realtime voice session, audio input/output, or voice picker.

features.feature: Interrupt spoken replies and switch to typing
features.assessment: Text turns can be interrupted, but no spoken-turn UI exists.

features.feature: Coordinate other running tasks through voice
features.assessment: No realtime task delegation or voice handoff interface.

features.feature: Share frontmost app context in a voice session
features.assessment: Requires both native appshots and live voice.

features.feature: Analyze or transcribe attached audio
features.assessment: May be possible with configured tools or local software; no dedicated Sele audio-understanding pipeline.

features.feature: Take a desktop screenshot from the composer
features.assessment: Pasting an image is supported; there is no screen/window/region capture action.

features.feature: Take and attach a webcam photo
features.assessment: No webcam capture interface.

features.feature: Attach local files to a prompt
features.assessment: File attachments are normalized and passed to the provider.

features.feature: Mention project files and folders
features.assessment: The composer searches project files and attaches selected references.

features.feature: Attach and discuss images
features.assessment: Image paths/data and dimensions are transported to Codex.

features.feature: Generate new images
features.assessment: Requires Codex image generation or an installed image tool/skill. Sele renders resulting media.

features.feature: Edit images using prompts and references
features.assessment: The tool backend performs edits; Sele can supply references and display outputs.

features.feature: Give region-specific feedback across generated images
features.assessment: Expanded media viewing exists; no canvas with region comments and multi-image annotation selection.

features.feature: Browse a persistent generated-image library
features.assessment: Sele provides conversation media galleries; no account-wide ChatGPT image library.

features.feature: Inspect image and video outputs in chat
features.assessment: Media galleries, lightboxes, and video previews are implemented.

features.feature: Search the web with the agent
features.assessment: The installed Codex runtime supplies hosted search when enabled.

features.feature: Render linked sources and citations
features.assessment: Markdown links and tool output are displayed; this does not imply every ChatGPT rich source card.

features.feature: Use a dedicated Deep Research workflow
features.assessment: Codex can research with tools; no ChatGPT Deep Research mode, planning interface, or hosted report view.

features.feature: Create and edit files in the working directory
features.assessment: Codex tools or plugins perform the file work; Sele exposes the project files.

features.feature: Create Word and PDF deliverables with skills
features.assessment: Requires the corresponding skill, software dependencies, or connected tools; no bundled office editor.

features.feature: Create spreadsheet deliverables with skills
features.assessment: Requires spreadsheet skill/tool dependencies and compatible provider access.

features.feature: Create presentation deliverables with skills
features.assessment: Requires presentation skill/tool dependencies and compatible provider access.

features.feature: Apply or create reusable artifact templates
features.assessment: Compatible template skills may operate on files; Sele has no native template library.

features.feature: Preview Word, PowerPoint, and spreadsheet artifacts
features.assessment: The built-in editor and media views do not provide native office-format previews.

features.feature: Preview PDF pages inside the artifact pane
features.assessment: Electron’s browser can potentially open PDFs; a dedicated generated-PDF viewer workflow is not established.

features.feature: Open generated HTML as an interactive preview
features.assessment: The browser and visualization host can display interactive content; no artifact viewer with paired HTML source/preview.

features.feature: Edit LaTeX alongside a live compiled PDF
features.assessment: No integrated LaTeX compiler or synchronized PDF preview.

features.feature: Annotate generated documents and slides
features.assessment: Code review comments exist; there is no office/PDF artifact annotation interface.

features.feature: Run code to analyze data and create charts
features.assessment: Codex can run installed Python/software; this is not the hosted ChatGPT analysis sandbox.

features.feature: Expand tables for inspection
features.assessment: TableLightbox expands rendered Markdown tables.

features.feature: Select individual data cells for agent analysis
features.assessment: Markdown table viewing does not provide the ChatGPT data-frame selection workflow.

features.feature: Reuse files from an account-level saved-file library
features.assessment: Recent project files exist; no hosted file library or account file retrieval interface.

features.feature: Render interactive visualizations in conversation
features.assessment: Sele embeds visualization artifacts with a sandboxed runtime.

features.feature: Render diagrams, math, and highlighted code
features.assessment: Markdown supports diagrams, mathematics, tables, and code formatting.

features.feature: Publish or share visualization artifacts
features.assessment: Local visualization viewing exists; no hosted sharing, embed link, or Space publishing UI.

features.feature: Browse and search project files
features.assessment: Sele has a file tree, file search, and navigation.

features.feature: Edit code and text with a built-in editor
features.assessment: Monaco editing and unsaved-change handling are integrated.

features.feature: Inspect changes and unified diffs
features.assessment: Working-tree diffs and changed-file navigation are integrated.

features.feature: Attach code selections and review comments to prompts
features.assessment: Editor and diff comments become structured review context.

features.feature: Stage or revert files and selected hunks
features.assessment: Sele stages selected changes as part of committing; no standalone stage/unstage or Git-revert UI was found.

features.feature: Commit and push from the app
features.assessment: Git sync controls and generated commit messages are provided.

features.feature: Switch, create, and remove branches
features.assessment: Branch management is built into the workspace.

features.feature: Start the provider’s structured review mode
features.assessment: Sele review comments are input context; no review/start call or dedicated /review mode.

features.feature: Compare review scopes and multiple repositories
features.assessment: Local diffs and multi-root projects exist; provider-native multi-repo review aggregation is not implemented.

features.feature: Browse and review remote pull requests
features.assessment: No native PR inbox, remote review viewer, or publish-review interface; tools may perform remote actions.

features.feature: Pull live context from the external IDE
features.assessment: File references are supported; no /ide-context live integration.

features.feature: Open project files in an external application
features.assessment: Sele exposes operating-system open/reveal actions.

features.feature: Use integrated interactive terminal sessions
features.assessment: PTY sessions, resize, and terminal IPC are implemented.

features.feature: Give the agent selected terminal output
features.assessment: No native terminal-selection or buffer-to-agent attachment action was found; copying and pasting text remains possible.

features.feature: Inspect and terminate the agent’s background terminals
features.assessment: Sele terminal sessions are separate; no thread/backgroundTerminals list/terminate controls.

features.feature: Run shell commands and interactive processes
features.assessment: Codex owns exec_command/write_stdin and shell execution; Sele renders the activity.

features.feature: Read, search, and patch repository files
features.assessment: Built-in Codex shell and file-editing tools are inherited.

features.feature: Create an isolated Git worktree for a chat
features.assessment: Sele creates named agents/* branches and worktrees before starting chats.

features.feature: Hand a chat and changes between Local and Worktree
features.assessment: Creating or forking into a worktree is not the provider’s bidirectional Handoff operation.

features.feature: Copy ignored files using .worktreeinclude
features.assessment: No .worktreeinclude integration is implemented.

features.feature: Automatically clean managed worktrees
features.assessment: Manual branch/worktree removal exists; no provider-style scheduled cleanup policy.

features.feature: Run shared worktree setup scripts automatically
features.assessment: No native .codex local-environment setup runner.

features.feature: Launch reusable project commands and prompts
features.assessment: Sele actions support project/global scope and keybindings.

features.feature: Read and share Codex local-environment definitions
features.assessment: Sele actions use a different settings model, not the provider’s .codex environment definition.

features.feature: Run agents and tools on an SSH host
features.assessment: Sele supports configured SSH environments. Browser forwarding remains separate.

features.feature: Run in Docker, Podman, Distrobox, or Toolbox
features.assessment: Provider launch and source selection support container targets; provider-specific restrictions apply.

features.feature: Use Windows Subsystem for Linux projects
features.assessment: Windows packaging exists; full WSL configuration and shared-auth parity have not been demonstrated.

features.feature: Pair devices and hand work between hosts
features.assessment: SSH access exists; no remoteControl pairing/client registry or host-to-host chat handoff.

features.feature: Delegate to Codex Cloud from the desktop
features.assessment: No cloud environment selection, hosted run, or apply-result interface; CLI in the terminal is an escape hatch.

features.feature: Create one-off or recurring scheduled tasks
features.assessment: No scheduler, scheduled-task store, or task-management UI.

features.feature: Start scheduled work from connected-app events
features.assessment: No app-event subscription or trigger-to-task dispatcher.

features.feature: Test, pause, inspect, and edit scheduled runs
features.assessment: No scheduled-run history or lifecycle controls.

features.feature: Run scheduled tasks in isolated worktrees
features.assessment: Manual worktree support exists; no scheduler-to-worktree integration.

features.feature: Receive operating-system completion and input alerts
features.assessment: Conversation badges exist; no OS notification integration was found.

features.feature: Choose notification sounds and delivery policy
features.assessment: No dedicated notification settings or completion/background policy.

features.feature: Choose a floating animated desktop pet
features.assessment: No pet overlay, selector, or activity companion.

features.feature: Install or create a custom animated pet
features.assessment: A pet skill/tool might create assets; Sele has no renderer or activation lifecycle.

features.feature: Start quick chats or voice from a floating companion
features.assessment: No pet/minimal overlay or quick-chat surface.

features.feature: Use Codex Micro keys, dial, lights, and voice controls
features.assessment: No Codex Micro discovery, device configuration, or status integration.

features.feature: Open a global quick-chat or companion window
features.assessment: No globalShortcut or always-on-top companion-chat registration was found.

features.feature: Pop out a chat and keep it always on top
features.assessment: Sele dialogs are in-app overlays, not independent pinned chat windows.

features.feature: Prevent sleep while local tasks run
features.assessment: No powerSaveBlocker integration was found. A provider feature flag alone does not prove app behavior.

features.feature: Open chats, settings, plugins, or pets via deep links
features.assessment: Sele does not register the codex:// navigation scheme.

features.feature: Find app commands in a command palette
features.assessment: Custom action menus exist; no complete searchable global command palette.

features.feature: Customize app keyboard commands
features.assessment: Custom actions have keybindings; global app command remapping is not implemented.

features.feature: Discover and dispatch the app’s slash command set
features.assessment: Sele has file/skill mentions; literal /commands are not dispatched as desktop or CLI actions.

features.feature: Choose light/dark appearance and UI/code fonts
features.assessment: Theme and font preferences are exposed in Sele.

features.feature: Customize colors and share theme definitions
features.assessment: Theme/font controls exist; full palette editing and theme import/export are not established.

features.feature: Restore unfinished composer drafts
features.assessment: Sele persists composer drafts and message-edit state.

features.feature: Check for and install desktop app updates
features.assessment: Sele has its own update mechanisms, documented per platform.

features.feature: Install on Linux, macOS, and Windows
features.assessment: Sele packages all three platforms; this audit does not exercise each package.

features.feature: Export diagnostic logs
features.assessment: Local log export includes failures and runtime/app metadata.

features.feature: Send feedback directly to OpenAI
features.assessment: Sele can export logs; no feedback/upload or OpenAI feedback dialog integration.

features.feature: Sign in using a ChatGPT account
features.assessment: Browser login and device-code results are supported by the adapter.

features.feature: Authenticate with provider API credentials
features.assessment: Existing Codex API-key authentication can be used; Sele is not a ChatGPT subscription portal.

features.feature: Add and switch Codex accounts on every OS
features.assessment: Codex account switching is Linux-only; Claude account switching has broader support.

features.feature: Sign out and reauthenticate
features.assessment: Linux account removal and login exist; no general account/logout RPC or Codex reauthentication flow. Reauthentication is currently Claude-only.

features.feature: Refresh externally managed ChatGPT auth tokens
features.assessment: account/chatgptAuthTokens/refresh server requests are not handled.

features.feature: See account rate limits and token usage
features.assessment: Usage, rate limits, reset credits, and token panels are integrated.

features.feature: Consume earned rate-limit reset credits
features.assessment: The adapter implements the reset-credit consumption RPC.

features.feature: Track estimated token costs
features.assessment: Sele token pricing and usage reporting provide estimates.

features.feature: Buy credits or manage the ChatGPT plan
features.assessment: No native billing, subscription, or credits-purchase flow.

features.feature: Manage partner apps that use Sign in with ChatGPT
features.assessment: No partner authorization/usage management interface in Sele.

features.feature: Edit a profile and share usage or streak cards
features.assessment: Sele shows usage, but no OpenAI profile editor, streak card, or referral system.

features.feature: Inspect and change provider feature flags
features.assessment: Experimental-feature discovery and config writes populate settings.

features.feature: Edit structured provider feature settings
features.assessment: Structured editing uses a checked-in schema subset; new complex fields may not have a suitable form.

features.feature: Edit every Codex config option through UI
features.assessment: Provider feature controls are not a complete config.toml editor; manual provider config remains necessary.

features.feature: Inspect profiles and effective configuration layers
features.assessment: Sele reads layers for safe writes, but does not expose the complete precedence/profile debugger.

features.feature: Configure provider paths and execution sources
features.assessment: Explicit provider executable paths and host/container source settings are supported.

features.feature: Upgrade the installed Codex runtime
features.assessment: Sele exposes provider update discovery and installation.

features.feature: Use Codex’s native terminal interface inside Sele
features.assessment: It can be launched in Sele’s terminal; the graphical chat is a separate app-server client.

features.feature: Run noninteractive or scripted Codex tasks
features.assessment: Available through the installed CLI and terminal; no native Sele batch-run interface.

features.feature: Consume JSONL events and structured output in scripts
features.assessment: CLI exec scripting works outside the graphical chat contract.

features.feature: Inspect or restart the Codex background daemon
features.assessment: No /daemon or daemon management UI. Sele owns its app-server process lifecycle.

features.feature: Configure terminal themes, Vim keys, and leader keys
features.assessment: Native TUI behavior is available when launching codex in a terminal, not in Sele chat.

features.feature: Install shell completions for Codex
features.assessment: Use codex completion from a shell; Sele does not install shell configuration.

features.feature: Inspect every native CLI status/configuration screen
features.assessment: Sele has usage, settings, and transcripts; native /status, /warnings, /debug-config remain CLI interfaces.

features.feature: Diagnose CLI setup using the built-in doctor
features.assessment: The installed codex doctor command can run in a terminal; no structured Sele diagnosis screen.

features.feature: Build and deploy a hosted Site
features.assessment: Possible through a connected Sites plugin; not a native Sele hosting service.

features.feature: Use Site storage, auth, and connected data
features.assessment: Depends on hosted Sites tools, account access, and supported authorization flows.

features.feature: Manage Site domains, analytics, and deployments
features.assessment: Configured tools may perform operations; no dedicated Sele site-management UI.

features.feature: Publish Site updates and manage access
features.assessment: Requires the hosting service and connected tool permissions; no native publishing controls.

features.feature: Create or edit Space Pages through connected tools
features.assessment: A configured Space plugin can expose APIs; Sele has no native Pages workspace.

features.feature: Use the collaborative Space block editor
features.assessment: No native block editor, sharing UI, page comments, or collaborative presence.

features.feature: Set up and supervise an ongoing dot assistant
features.assessment: No dot identity, messaging channel setup, supervision, or persistent task UI.

features.feature: Use the Codex Security plugin
features.assessment: Connected security tools may execute; permissions and rich workbench flows remain conditional.

features.feature: Review findings in the Security workbench
features.assessment: No native findings inbox, triage UI, or security workbench.

features.feature: Co-edit text or code in Canvas
features.assessment: Sele edits local files and accepts comments; no hosted Canvas version/suggestion workflow.

features.feature: Choose a custom GPT in a conversation
features.assessment: Sele skills/plugins are distinct from the ChatGPT custom-GPT runtime.

features.feature: Read context from a supported external IDE or notes app
features.assessment: Sele reads project files; it does not implement Classic Work with Apps context capture.

features.feature: Edit code inside an external IDE from Classic
features.assessment: Sele’s built-in editor is separate from external-app patch application.

features.feature: Use Apple Handoff for a conversation
features.assessment: No Apple Handoff integration.

features.feature: Use menu-bar or dock integration and login launch
features.assessment: No corresponding Classic-style menu-bar/launch-at-login settings were found.

features.feature: Answer provider requests for the current time
features.assessment: The exported currentTime/read server callback has no handler and is rejected as unsupported.

features.feature: Handle legacy command and patch approval callbacks
features.assessment: Modern item approval callbacks are handled; legacy execCommandApproval and applyPatchApproval are not.

features.feature: Render every current protocol item kind
features.assessment: The installed protocol has 19 item variants; several rely on generic or absent handling. An unknown item type is not evidence of complete transcript parity.

features.feature: Copy messages and code blocks
features.assessment: Message and code-block copy controls are implemented; whole-transcript export is separate.

features.feature: Move several chats between projects at once
features.assessment: No multi-select conversation transfer action or provider project-move integration.

features.feature: Customize dictation cleanup and specialist vocabulary
features.assessment: No dictation recorder, cleanup pipeline, or custom vocabulary settings.

features.feature: Choose a light or dark app icon
features.assessment: No in-app Dock/icon customization control.

features.feature: Search across every settings panel
features.assessment: Resource and feature filtering exist; no unified all-settings search.

features.feature: Choose bottom or side placement for terminal tabs
features.assessment: Sele has a terminal panel and workspace scoping; no equivalent bottom-versus-right placement preference.

features.feature: Reorder queued follow-up messages with drag and drop
features.assessment: Editing/deletion and queued delivery exist; no drag ordering for pending messages.

features.feature: Warn when the requested model is downgraded
features.assessment: Model discovery and per-message labels exist; no dedicated downgrade warning flow.

features.feature: Review multiple outstanding approvals
features.assessment: Sele can store pending requests and approve per chat, but shows one current request rather than a complete parallel approval interface.

features.feature: Adjust zoom independently for each window
features.assessment: UI/code font controls exist; no explicit per-window zoom setting.

features.feature: Choose the application interface language
features.assessment: No localization catalog or interface-language selector was found.

features.feature: Navigate back and forward through app screens
features.assessment: Browser history controls exist; no comparable global screen-history navigation controls were found.

features.feature: Keep and reorder multiple source-file tabs
features.assessment: Recent files and editor dialogs exist; native thread-side-panel tab-strip and drag-order parity are not established.

features.feature: Keep the app in a system tray with usage controls
features.assessment: No native tray lifecycle or account-usage tray menu was found.

features.feature: Inspect subagent-specific diff statistics
features.assessment: Subagent transcripts and status exist; no dedicated per-subagent changed-file statistics surface was established.

features.feature: Review generated files through rich artifact cards
features.assessment: File references and media are shown; office/PDF citation cards and native review are not fully implemented.

features.feature: Keep pins synchronized with other first-party devices
features.assessment: Sele pins are local metadata, not the shared desktop/mobile account pin state.
